rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A multi-agent orchestrator MCP server built by yoriichi-07 that provides autonomous software development capabilities through specialized AI agents including an Autonomous Architect for dynamic system design, Proactive Quality Framework for policy-driven testing, Evolutionary Prompt Engine for self-optimization, and Last Mile Cloud Agent for multi-cloud deployment. The implementation features Descope OAuth 2.1 + PKCE authentication with scope-based authorization, Cequence AI Gateway integration for enterprise analytics and observability, self-healing code generation with automatic error detection and resolution, and support for 16 comprehensive tools spanning infrastructure management, code generation, quality assurance, and deployment automation. Built using FastMCP and FastAPI with structured logging, it supports multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), making it useful for enterprise development workflows, automated software generation, AI-assisted code review and optimization, and building self-maintaining applications with minimal human intervention.
